claims.claim_text: Eugene H Clapp has a confirmed match to the exact private identifier and compatible name in the official Army merged file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The Army record matches the indexed private identifier and core name and gives a 23 July 1942 Army-entry date.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact private identifier is decisive. The trailing SND text is preserved as found and is not expanded or used to change the indexed name.
claims.temporal_assessment: The record documents Army entry in July 1942, not when the occupational category was held or when any OSS association began.
claims.match_notes: No employer, suffix expansion or OSS transfer chronology is inferred.

claims.claim_text: An official Army-entry record assigns Eugene H Clapp the broad occupational category Accountants and auditors; no employer is identified.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: NARA's code list decodes the identifier-matched Army record's occupation value as Accountants and auditors.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact private identifier establishes that the Army row belongs to the indexed person.
claims.temporal_assessment: The code was captured at Army entry on 23 July 1942; whether it was his immediate pre-OSS work is unknown.
claims.match_notes: Occupation remains distinct from employer and self-employment; no organization is inferred.

claims.claim_text: A distinctive exact-name Army candidate for James W Clance carries a different private identifier from the OSS index; the records remain unmerged.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: An official Florida National Guard roster lists Corporal James W. Clance in Battery D at Daytona Beach; a same-name Army row has a different identifier.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The rare exact name, compatible corporal grade and later official history of a World War II paratrooper make this a strong candidate, but they cannot override the identifier conflict.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Guard roster documents 1940-1941 service, but no source establishes when or whether the indexed person entered OSS.
claims.match_notes: Battery D, the 82nd Airborne Division and the Army-entry occupation remain candidate evidence only and are excluded from default analytics.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA OSS index page 82 and complete Army bulk comparison; exact-name and Clair/Claire private-identifier OSS/CIA searches; employer, occupation, obituary, institutional, LoC newspaper and archival checks.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: The only exact-name Army row dates from January 1946 and lacks the indexed identifier; other Clair and Claire namesakes have no OSS or chronology bridge.
research_attempts.research_notes: The 1946 record may represent post-OSS enlistment or a namesake and remains private. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.
